description: Phase 09 Prompt 28 — unsupported claim checks + review routing. Each retrieved item presented as context is a 'claim'; a claim is supported iff it carries a source ref + an allowlisted (non-excluded) source family. Unsupported claims are detected and ROUTED TO HUMAN REVIEW (review_required, tier 3, reason code) so they are never presented as fact; supported-but-review-flagged claims (tier 3 / stale / conflict) are routed to review_recommended. This is advisory only: it makes NO final claim or entitlement determination (the claim_or_entitlement_decision_performed + unsupported_claim_performed guards stay 0), assembles no final answer, and persists metadata-only (no raw claim text/excerpt/source ref — only hashes, counts, family names, review vocabulary, and reasons). Read-only by default; receipts go to the existing V38 second_brain_retrieval_unsupported_claim_checks table.
